theory.hypothesis: If ETH moves by at least 0.5% over 10 minutes, it may continue in that direction in the short term.
theory.entry_rule: Buy when ETH is up at least 0.5% compared with its price 10 minutes ago.
theory.exit_rule: If holding ETH, sell when its price is down at least 0.5% compared with 10 minutes ago, reaches 2% below the average purchase price, or reaches 3% above it. Give the stop-loss and take-profit rules priority. Hold when no rule applies.
theory.risk_rule: Cap each buy at 5% of available cash and within Ledger’s transaction limit. Sell only ETH already held.
